scope: All capabilities run on this machine. The standalone trading and recorder services are installed on their own Linux hosts.
installDescription: Install Terminal, the local business services and default configuration. Terminal runs the local services itself when it starts; market data, trading and research still require their data sources, accounts and authorization.
upgradeDescription: Upgrade the local programs, preserving configuration and business data. Finish tasks, handle trading and close Terminal first.
uninstallDescription: Remove the local application and its launcher. Configuration and business data are kept by default; clear the option below to delete them as well.
stopInstructions: Finish tasks and handle trading safely in Terminal, then close Terminal; the local services exit with it. The installer never force-stops business work.
conflict: Installation needs attention. Review the reason below.
noPackage: No complete installation source is available. Run the installer containing Terminal.
preserveBody: Node identity, configuration, market data, tasks, trading records and secure storage are retained. Uninstalling does not cancel orders or close positions.
failureHelp: Review the reason below, correct it and check again. Failure never automatically deletes user data or starts trading.
success: Operation completed. User data was retained.
confirm: I confirm the operation scope and understand that user data is retained.
pending: An operation is unfinished. Select it to continue
installModeDescription: Install the complete local system for the current user. Installation never logs into a broker or starts trading.
upgradeModeDescription: An earlier version is installed. Update the programs and retain user data.
maintenanceModeDescription: Terminal is installed. Repair the programs or remove the installation.
resumeModeDescription: An operation is unfinished. Resolve its failure and continue with the same package version.
repairDescription: Redeploy the complete application from the same version package. Retain configuration, identity and business data; configuration is not reset and business data is not repaired.
olderPackage: The installed version is newer than this package. Downgrade and repair with this package are unavailable. Use the matching package to repair; uninstall remains available.
deleteTitle: Local configuration and business data will be permanently deleted
deleteBody: Uninstall will delete local configuration, account settings, market data, tasks and trading records in the directory below. This cannot be undone; uninstalling does not cancel orders or close positions.
deleteExclusions: Diagnostic logs are retained. OS keyring credentials, external exports and data on other machines are unaffected.
confirmDelete: I confirm permanent deletion of the local configuration and business data above and understand that this cannot be undone.
successRemovedData: Uninstall completed. The selected local configuration and business data were deleted.
failureDeleteHelp: Review the reason below, correct it and check again. If data deletion was selected, some content may already have been removed before failure; continuing does not restore deleted data.
